visualReview.notes: Inspected all10 final source images: overview, four turntables, white web, atrium seam, crown, entrance and far silhouette. The blue-glass bulging/tapered envelope and sharper crown agree with the inspected architect picture. Replaced straight strand beams that dipped into the glazing with strips projected onto the faceted skin; closer web is continuous. The threefold facade phase, number/routing of strands and entrance details remain reconstructed.

Canonical concrete and painted-metal graphs reused, with opaque glass PBR parameters and zero embedded images. Full tower, source-local exact-QID frame, retained long axis, terrain contact, graph cache and unloading pass. The separate egg-shaped hall is excluded. Geographic flat staging is separate from the source-local PMTiles contact preview.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all26 final lighting, LOD and transition images. All tiers retain the complete bulging cocoon and narrow crown. Skyline has coarse glass facets and broad continuous meridians; district adds sparse crossing strips. Street/closeup restore progressively denser web and closeup panel frames. Corrected low-tier strip subdivision prevents the earlier broken-arrow artifact. The surrounding terrain is a coarse urban DEM with bounded footprint/courtyard correction; synthetic neighbors are contextual fixtures, not actual Shinjuku buildings.

geographicReview.notes: One inspected architect exterior picture confirms the bulging/tapered cocoon, three-face glass and white wrapping web. Browser crown narrows to a tip in response to the picture; original blunt-crown master remains independently reproducible. Retain203.65m authored height, existing52.584×47.427m mapped envelope, exact-QID anchor and long axis. Standard viewer PMTiles confirms the Shinjuku tower/road context. Threefold facade phase and local entrances remain approximate. PMTiles off-footprint point[0,40]43.8772m sets approximate terrain contact; center69.1239m contains building imprint. Bounded preview contact removes that imprint while raw samples remain available. Separate egg-shaped hall, exact panel/strand counts, basement and threshold surveys are excluded.
